subject.title: fix(guarded-mkdir): allow in-root symlinked directory components

question: Should pinned writes accept an existing parent symlink that resolves inside the root in every supported Python-helper mode, or should symlinked parents remain uniformly rejected?
rationale: The helper’s `O_NOFOLLOW` traversal may encode a deliberate threat-model choice, so review cannot safely choose parity versus strict rejection without maintainer intent.

options.title: Implement cross-mode containment parity
options.body: Accept only symlinked parents that resolve inside the root in both helper and fallback paths, with focused allowed-target and escaping-target tests.

options.title: Keep symlinks uniformly disallowed
options.body: Retain the stricter helper contract and remove or gate the fallback-only acceptance so runtime mode cannot change the outcome.

options.title: Pause for contract design
options.body: Hold the PR until the filesystem-safety threat model documents whether contained parent symlinks are a supported write target.

recommendation.title: Implement cross-mode containment parity
recommendation.body: Accept only symlinked parents that resolve inside the root in both helper and fallback paths, with focused allowed-target and escaping-target tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignment and discussion specifically route the unresolved helper/fallback security contract to this owner.
